doc_friction.issue: rerun took over 7 minutes for three fast suites and reported line-21 mutants of oauth-setup.mjs as caught_after_fix: true while the test actually hung on them (a by-hand check showed the hang); a mutant that makes a spawned script wait forever needs the suite to time out on its own, and the tool's verdict should not be trusted for it without a manual check.

Step 0 says fix open entries first, but all 11 open entries are control-plane edits needing owner approval, so step 0 is a no-op for most runs; the list could mark control-plane entries as 'awaiting owner' so runs don't re-read them.

real_defects.issue: authUrl and exchangeCode threw a raw TypeError for an unknown OAUTH_PROVIDER (e.g. 'Google'), crashing oauth-setup.mjs after it opened its port; tokenProvider alone named the valid providers. Fixed with providerOf() and an up-front check in oauth-setup.mjs.

A declined consent (?error=access_denied) posted an empty code to the token endpoint and reported its invalid_grant/invalid_request, which reads like a misconfigured app. Now answers 400 'Authorization was not granted' and exits 1 without calling the token endpoint.
A stored counter that was a JSON array was kept, so every later count was lost (JSON.stringify drops named keys on an array). Found by the new checkParamModule contract.
A stored counter that was valid JSON but not a plain object ([], 5, "text", null, true) was kept; counting stopped for that visitor for good. Found by checkParamModule.
Same as vpat-acr-generator (same vendored copy). Found by checkParamModule.

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
